note: Declared authority: which critical surface each module belongs to. The catalogue generator validates that every module with a build file matches exactly one surface and that no declared pattern is stale; the impact planner reads this same file to report which surfaces a change touches. A new module that matches nothing fails `just fitness` instead of silently losing its regression coverage.

auxiliary_modules.pipeline-architecture-tests: architecture fitness only: no src/main, therefore no product surface
auxiliary_modules.pipeline-sdk-bom: BOM/platform module: declares constraints only, no production code
